svg.title: KST KenhSangTao.COM GOOT soldering iron controller wiring diagram
svg.desc: Professional vector wiring reference for an ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1, MAX31855, ST7789 display, EC11 encoder, IRLB8721 MOSFET, buzzer, stand switch, Makita 20V battery, DC-DC buck converter, and a four-pin GOOT soldering iron tip with SS+/SS− sensor pins and two MS heater pins.
svg.text: KST KenhSangTao.COM — ESP32-S3 GOOT Soldering Iron Controller
Complete point-to-point wiring reference • Direct Makita 20V battery input • Shared Common GND

g.text: SS+/SS− SENSOR • TWO MS HEATER TERMINALS
